identitySignals: Berkeley School of Education (bse.berkeley.edu, formerly the Graduate School of Education at gse.berkeley.edu, which redirects there) is the education school of UC Berkeley, matching the agenda's 'UC Berkeley Graduate School of Education' and 'Berkeley, CA'
Its contact page gives a Berkeley, CA 94720 address at the University of California, Berkeley

Its own news page describes a partnership with Oakland Unified School District, and it runs teacher preparation programs, matching OUSD's Talent/Human Resources MOU for teaching intern and practica programs
research.notes: Agency is the Regents of the University of California (public university); the school is a unit of UC Berkeley. The only general email on the contact page is a graduate admissions inbox, so email was left null. Legal name and registry IDs left null since not shown on cited pages.

profile.summary: The Berkeley School of Education is the education school of the University of California, Berkeley, a public university. It offers doctoral, master's and undergraduate programs, prepares teachers and school leaders, and carries out education research and professional development.

sources.title: Contact Us - Berkeley School of Education

review.notes: The Berkeley School of Education (formerly the Graduate School of Education) is the UC Berkeley unit named in the agenda, and the Regents of the University of California is its legal contracting body. The cited home and contact pages support the summary, website and address. The OUSD partnership page covers National Board Certification support rather than intern placements, but it is cited only as an identity signal and does not affect any profile field.
